claim: A second observation on r806919.Wizard_1_610, from a web (browser-launcher) install rather than a KingsIsle-launcher or Steam one, confirms the Bin/revision.dat and Bin/data.dat byte layouts, records the LocalPackagesList.txt shape on this revision (3,433 single-token CRLF records), and records that this install carries neither AppStart.dat nor Wizard101launcher-data.yml anywhere.
disproof: A repeatable inspection of a web install at the same revision that finds a different revision.dat length or terminator, non-identical Bin/data.dat bytes, a different LocalPackagesList.txt record count or delimiter shape, or the presence of AppStart.dat or Wizard101launcher-data.yml refutes this finding.
evidence: Bin/revision.dat is 21 bytes: 20 printable ASCII bytes, no BOM, no CR bytes, one trailing LF. Bin/data.dat is also 21 bytes and compared byte-for-byte equal.
LocalPackagesList.txt is 148,767 bytes with 3,433 CRLF sequences, no lone LF or CR bytes and no BOM. Splitting on CRLF yields 3,433 nonempty single-token records and one empty trailing record.
No record contains a comma, semicolon, tab, space or path separator. The records use 64 distinct bytes, all printable ASCII; token lengths run 9 to 93 bytes with a median of 41.
Neither AppStart.dat nor Wizard101launcher-data.yml exists anywhere in this install: no match under Bin/ or at the install root.
The install was obtained through the web (browser) launcher, and Bin/revision.dat identifies it as r806919.Wizard_1_610.
how_to_repeat: On your own web install, read Bin/revision.dat as bytes; confirm the file has 21 bytes, bytes 0-19 are printable ASCII with no BOM and no CR, and byte 20 is LF. Do not copy the identifier into a report.
Compare the bytes of Bin/revision.dat and Bin/data.dat locally; confirm they are identical without printing either value.

Read LocalPackagesList.txt at the install root as bytes without printing values; count the CRLF sequences, confirm there are no lone LF or CR bytes and no BOM, and count nonempty versus empty records after splitting on CRLF.

For each nonempty record, confirm it holds a single token: no commas, semicolons, tabs, spaces or path separators. Record only the distinct byte count, the printable range, and the minimum, median and maximum token lengths.
Search the whole install, Bin/ and the root, for AppStart.dat and Wizard101launcher-data.yml by filename; record presence or absence without printing any file content.
subject: revision_files_web_install_observation
